newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bangkok Bank sees no impact from measures.
newsitem.headline: Bangkok Bank sees no impact from measures.

text.p: Thailand's top commercial bank Bangkok Bank Plc said on Thursday the central banks's new strict measures requiring banks to raise provisions for sub-standard loans will have no impact on the bank's profit.

"Bangkok Bank has already set provision of doubtful loans by more than 300 percent. Therefore, the new measures will have no adverse affect on the bank's profit," bank president Chartsiri Sophonpanich told reporters.
The central bank earlier this week ordered commercial banks and finance companies to set aside provisions for their substandard loans amounting to 50 billion baht.
It also asked commercial banks to raise provisions for doubtful loans and assets to 115 percent from a current 100 percent.
"If the economy remains sluggish in the longer term, the banks will have to increase their provision (for doubtful loans). This may affect the bank's profit," Chartsiri said.
